simplefarming.title: Simple Farming
simplefarming.option.preventFarmlandTram:
If enabled, players with Feather Falling
boots will not trample farmland. Default:
true.
If enabled, Sharpness III+ weapons cut
through grass/flowers when attacking
entities. Default: true.
simplefarming.option.enableHoeHarvest.to:
Right-click fully grown crops with a hoe to
harvest and replant them. Consumes
durability. Default: true.
simplefarming.option.grassCutMinSharpnes:
Sharpness level a sword or axe needs to cut the
grass around its target and swing through grass.
Default: 1. Range: 1-5.
simplefarming.option.grassThroughMinPerc:
Chance in percent to hit a mob through grass
with Sharpness I; rises linearly up to the
Sharpness V value. Default: 10.
simplefarming.option.grassThroughMaxPerc:
Chance in percent to hit a mob through grass
with Sharpness V. Default: 90.
simplefarming.option.grassSweepRadiusPer:
Extra rings of blocks cut around the target per
Sweeping Edge level (basic area is 3x3).
Default: 1. Range: 0-3.
